id: \bI'm the first of the Winstrate family. Think you can win?
en: \bI'm the first of the Winstrate family. Think you can win?
it: \bSono il primo della famiglia Vincenti. Credi di poter vincere?

id: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bGran bella lotta. Buona fortuna con il resto.

id: \rI'm going to be a bit harder okay?

id: \bIt's said that some Pokémon evolve from this, but I can't figure it out. You take it.
en: \bIt's said that some Pokémon evolve from this, but I can't figure it out. You take it.

id: \bCome show me your new evolved friend sometime.
en: \bCome show me your new evolved friend sometime.
it: \bVieni a mostrarmi il tuo nuovo amico evoluto, una volta o l'altra.
